listings.name: Red Bud Isle
listings.dog_policy_summary: City materials identify Red Bud Isle as a designated off-leash area. Dogs must be leashed while entering and leaving, remain within sight and sound control, and handlers must remove waste.

evidence.supports: Official park name and public park street address.
City off-leash rules, general park hours, and notice that access can change.
Current City waterway advisory reporting blue-green algae at Red Bud Isle and explaining the risk to dogs.

uncertainty: The City reported blue-green algae at Red Bud Isle on October 6, 2026; some blue-green algae can produce toxins that harm or kill dogs.
Keep dogs away from visible algae and check the current City algae advisory before any water contact.
Maintenance, events, water conditions, or posted notices can also limit access.
Confirm current City notices and signs before allowing a dog off leash.

listings.name: Meanwhile Brewing Company
listings.dog_policy_summary: The official FAQ welcomes well-behaved dogs when they remain leashed, excludes dogs from the soccer field, and says misbehaving dogs may be asked to leave.

evidence.supports: Official dog policy and business-level street address.

uncertainty: The FAQ does not guarantee space, event access, weather suitability, or service at a particular time.
Recheck the official FAQ and current hours before visiting.

listings.name: McKinney Falls State Park
listings.dog_policy_summary: The current park map requires pets to remain attended on a leash no longer than six feet. Pets are not allowed in the water, public buildings, cabin area, or youth group area.

evidence.supports: Official park identity, public park street address, capacity warning, hours, and restriction against pets in the water.
Current facility-map rules for leash length, attendance, water, buildings, cabins, and youth areas.

uncertainty: The park can reach capacity and creek conditions can change after rainfall.
Confirm current conditions and entry availability with the park before travel.
